title: Reference Harness memory retrieval probe
question: Can the Reference Harness retrieve a task-relevant memory source and select the declared skill without loading unrelated memory?
hypothesis: Both repetitions will cite AGENTS.md#testing, select test-first, return the expected plan, and share one normalized Trace fingerprint.
success_criteria: Both repetitions cite only the declared testing memory source and select the test-first skill.
Both repetitions return the expected plan and share one normalized Trace fingerprint.
limitations: Retrieval uses a small deterministic teaching index, not embeddings or a production memory service.
The probe does not measure ranking quality on ambiguous or adversarial corpora.
The Reference Harness result is not Native vendor evidence.
